quote: We use PANDA to train a seq2seq controlled generation model, the perturber. The perturber takes in (i) a source text snippet, (ii) a word in the snippet referring to a demographic group, and (iii) a new target demographic attribute, and generates a perturbed snippet that refers to the target demographic attribute, while preserving overall meaning.

The perturber takes in (i) a source text snippet, (ii) a word in the snippet referring to a demographic group, and (iii) a new target demographic attribute, and generates a perturbed snippet that refers to the target demographic attribute, while preserving overall meaning.
We frame training a demographic perturber as a conditional sequence-to-sequence task. Given input snippet s, perturbable word w and target attribute a t , we seek to learn P ( s|s, w, a t )...

We randomly selected 200 examples from the PANDA validation set to be perturbed by the perturber. The perturber outputs are annotated by 2 expert annotators; each example was annotated by both experts to calculate interannotator agreement.
guideline: Annotators were tasked with identifying imperfections such as incomplete or incorrect perturbation, Stage 1 errors, typos and naturalness, incorrectly unperturbed, and factuality changes.

Annotators evaluated perturbed outputs using predefined error categories such as factuality change, incomplete/incorrect perturbation, stage 1 errors, typos and naturalness, and incorrectly unperturbed.
